bestPractices.title: Tips for a good request
tips: Be specific: describe what's wrong, since when, and what you've already tried.
Mention if it's urgent or if you have a preferred time window.
If relevant, include measurements, brand or model of the equipment or material.
Add photos or a video: they help you get chosen faster.
